subject: New life history hindcaster Shiny apps

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: New life history hindcaster Shiny apps
parts:
Dear NicheMapR users,
I recently added three new Shiny apps that integrate the microclimate, ectotherm and DEB models:
  • Global Ectotherm Life History Hindcaster - driven by microclimatic conditions any time from 1949 to last month.
  • Australian Ectotherm Life History Hindcaster - driven by microclimatic conditions any time from 1889 to yesterday.
  • USA Ectotherm Life History Hindcaster - driven by microclimatic conditions any time from 1980 to yesterday.
You can choose from any of the ~6000 species with DEB parameters in the AmP collection and simulate their life histories from a given starting date and stage. Let me know if you come across any issues.
All the best,
Mike
